title: Good habits for staying clean
summary: Practise keeping your body clean and saving water every day.
keyIdeas: Washing hands with soap and water helps remove dirt and microbes.
Brushing twice a day with fluoride toothpaste, including before bed, helps prevent tooth decay.
Turning off the tap while soaping helps save water.

basicKnowledge: A. Cultura científica › La vida en nuestro planeta

activities.prompt: Aisha comes back from the playground for a snack. What should she do before touching food?
activities.explanation: Soap and water help remove dirt and microbes before eating.
options: Wash her hands with soap and water
Wipe her hands on her trousers

activities.prompt: Washing hands with only water removes every microbe.
activities.explanation: Water alone does not remove all dirt and grease. Soap helps remove microbes when we rinse.

activities.prompt: Match each item to its correct use.
activities.explanation: We use different items to keep our bodies clean and dry.

activities.prompt: Put the handwashing steps in order.
activities.explanation: First wet your hands, then rub with soap, rinse and dry well.
items: Rub with soap to make a lather
Dry well with a clean towel

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence about caring for our mouths.
activities.explanation: Brushing with fluoride toothpaste helps prevent tooth decay.
activities.sentence: Hugo brushes his teeth to help prevent ___.

activities.prompt: Sort these actions into healthy and unhealthy habits.
activities.explanation: Keeping clean and not sharing personal items help prevent illness.

items.text: Use a clean tissue when sneezing
Wear sweaty clothes for several days

activities.prompt: Omar washes his hands with soap and water. Why does he use soap?
activities.explanation: Soap helps remove dirt when we rinse our hands.
activities.hint: Think about what gets on your hands when you play.
options: So he does not have to rinse

activities.prompt: Lucía hears three tips in class. Which tip is wrong?
activities.explanation: Leaving the tap running wastes water. Turn it off while rubbing with soap.
activities.hint: Look for the action that wastes water.
options: Leave the tap running while soaping your hands
Turn off the tap while brushing your teeth
Take a short shower to use less water

activities.prompt: Leo needs to sneeze but has no tissue. How should he cover his nose and mouth?
activities.explanation: Using the inside of the elbow keeps microbes off our hands, which touch other things.
activities.hint: If you use your hand, you then touch objects.
options: With the inside of his elbow
Without covering them, towards his classmates

activities.prompt: Read the text and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Keeping clean and saving water help care for our health and nature.
activities.title: Nerea's routine
activities.text: Nerea and her brother care for their bodies each day. In the morning, they wash their faces. After a meal, they brush their teeth for two minutes. After the park, they shower with soap. They turn off the tap while soaping to save water.

questions.prompt: How long do they brush their teeth?
questions.explanation: The text says they brush for two minutes after a meal.

questions.prompt: Why do they turn off the tap while soaping?
questions.explanation: Turning off the tap saves water and helps care for our planet.
options: To avoid making noise at home
